bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided product review records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks on provided metadata tables, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using Matplotlib.
As part of supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the public policy text workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out policy document groups using scikit-learn; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins for policy document metadata with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using Matplotlib.
As part of supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins on provided product metadata tables with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules using Matplotlib.
